verdict.rationale: Kong documents declarative configuration and the decK CLI for automating gateway configuration, with Terraform providers to manage many Kong entities as code. That implies applying configuration across many entities at once, but no source explicitly describes bulk create, update or delete operations or their scope. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation documentation (batch edits or deletes across many entities), details of decK sync/apply semantics at scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
